# cork-primary-nav

The site's main menu. Add it as a child of the cork-header element, which opens it in its nav tray.
In progress.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headerComponentLabel` | `String` | Label for the menu, e.g. in the header's nav tray. Default: 'Main Menu'. Attribute: header-component-label. |
| `focusedNavItem` | `Number[]` | navPosition of the focused item, e.g. [1, 0]. Attribute: focused-nav-item, comma-separated (e.g. "1,0"). |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Menu: a ul/ol of li elements, nested for sub menus. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM. |

## Methods

### static get shadowRootOptions

Lit shadow root options. delegatesFocus forwards focus() on the element to its first focusable control,
e.g. when cork-header opens its nav tray.

### onNavTrayHide()

Called by cork-header when its nav tray hides this element. Collapses any open submenus,
so the menu reopens collapsed.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-primary-nav';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkPrimaryNav from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-primary-nav/cork-primary-nav.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-primary-nav>
  <ul>
    <li>
      <a href="/services">Services</a>
      <ul>
        <li><a href="/services/borrow">Borrowing</a></li>
      </ul>
    </li>
  </ul>
</cork-primary-nav>
```
